title: Symmetry conjecture for the special values of $L_{+}$
statement:
Let $L_{+}$ be the function appearing in the paper, and let $\mathscr{C}$ be its associated constant. **Symmetry conjecture.** The values $L_{+}(2k)$ satisfy the following symmetry:

$$
L_{+}(-2k) = \frac{L_{+}(2k)}{(2\pi i\mathscr{C})^{2k}},\qquad k\in\mathbb{Z}.
$$

This symmetry is conjectured for the special values at negative even integers and has been verified numerically to very high precision.
references:
**4 papers in this index state this conjecture** (2013–2025). The statement above is taken from the most recent of them; the others are [arXiv:1703.01955](https://arxiv.org/abs/1703.01955), [arXiv:1508.00498](https://arxiv.org/abs/1508.00498), [arXiv:1301.3600](https://arxiv.org/abs/1301.3600).

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.05205

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of April 2025).
source_name: Andriy Bondarenko, Joaquim Ortega-Cerdà, Danylo Radchenko and Kristian Seip, “The Hörmander–Bernhardsson extremal function”, arXiv:2504.05205 (2026).
